narrative.overview:
Bloom is a dark room with the film art as its only light. The page is Theatre Black, the text is one ink, Screen White, and every surface the interface needs is a pane of smoked glass laid over the artwork: the account sheet, the player's panels, the tab bar on the phone, the card on the connect screen. Colour belongs to the posters and the backdrops; the interface never competes with them. The mood is cinematic, quiet and precise: the home page opens on a full-bleed backdrop with the title treatment and a single white Play button, and everything else sits one step back.

The system is the same on the Mac and the phone and native on each. The Mac has the top bar with the server name and the libraries, the floating poster on a detail page and the pointer's hover states. The phone has a glass tab bar at the bottom, menus as sheets that rise from the bottom, three posters across, and fields and buttons at the sizes a finger expects. Shared code is an implementation detail; what the user sees is their platform's app.

Density is generous. Rows are 38 points or taller, cards have 27 points between them, text stays at 15 points for reading and 12 for detail, and nothing is packed to fit. Two things were tried and rejected: a dark scrim over the glass, which read as a foreign blob, and a white wash with a uniform ring, which read as a flat grey outlined button. Glass controls draw no ring.
keyCharacteristics: One ink, Screen White, at three opacities; colour means a state, never a kind of thing
Smoked glass surfaces with a light edge; depth from translucency, never from shadows
Film art full-bleed behind the interface, with a shade only where text must stay readable
Native structure per platform: top bar and hover on the Mac, tab bar and sheets on the phone
Google Sans for everything the user reads, Geist Mono for logs and paths

Motion marks arrival only: pages push from the right on a phone and lift into place on the Mac, sheets rise, popups settle, changes in place fade; 150 or 200 ms on one ease-out curve, off under Reduce Motion

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and icons are Screen White, quieter text is the same ink at lower opacity, icons sit on the disc. A different colour for each kind of thing, tinted tiles, coloured badges and gradients on cards were rejected as slop on 2026-10-03.

rules.name: The Colour Is State Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean live, needs a look, and failed. A badge is a quiet pill; a state shows as a dot. No other colour is the interface's own; the rest comes from the artwork.

rules.name: The Phone Reads at 17 Rule
rules.body: On a phone, a field or a button is 50 points tall with 17-point text, the body size of Dynamic Type; a tap target is never under 44 points. The Mac keeps 44-point fields and 15-point text.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If a surface needs to read as above another, it is glass with a light edge, and the blur does the lifting.

rules.name: The Glass Shows Through Rule
rules.body: A glass surface never hides what it covers; a dark scrim over glass and a white wash under a ring were both rejected. On a phone the frost rises to keep text readable, and that is the only exception.

rules.name: The Arrival Rule
rules.body: Motion marks where something came from: pushed pages from the right, sheets from the bottom, popups from just above their place, a replaced page from just below it. Nothing else moves.

rules.name: The Quiet Return Rule
rules.body: Going back fades; only going forward slides.

dos: Do use Screen White (#f5f5f7) for all text and icons, and lower its opacity to 70%, 60% or 50% for secondary, detail and quiet text.

Do draw every popup, sheet, panel and bar as smoked glass with the one-pixel light edge, rows of 38 points or more with 12-point corners and 12-point padding, 15-point body text and 12-point detail text.
Do let the artwork carry the colour; keep the interface black, white and grey.
Do keep one white primary button per page and make every other action quiet glass.
Do build the phone's structure from the platform's own patterns: a tab bar, sheets from the bottom, 50-point fields with 17-point text, 44-point tap targets, the safe area respected.
Do keep a menu, the episode list and a panel exclusive: open one, close the rest.
Do give what arrives its entrance from ui::motion (push, rise, settle or fade) and nothing more; honour Reduce Motion.
donts: Don't give a kind of thing a colour: no rainbow avatars, tinted icon tiles, coloured category badges or gradients on cards.
Don't cast shadows. Depth is translucency and the light edge.
Don't put a dark scrim over glass, or a white wash with a uniform ring around a glass control; both were rejected.
Don't add a second accent colour. Green, amber and red are states, not accents.
Don't reinvent a native control on the phone for flavour; the glass is the brand, the structure is the platform's.
Don't shrink text below 12 points, or a tap target below 44.
Don't animate for show: no bounce, no spring, no movement on hover, and no entrance longer than 200 ms.
